| <a id="REQ-001"></a>REQ-001 | Submit leave request | FUNCTIONAL |  | MEDIUM | An employee can submit a leave request for a leave type available to them (for example Paid Leave, Maternity Leave or another type). Leave is requested in full days or half days (morning or afternoon). The leave dates may be in the future, or in the past only when they fall within the current month; leave from the previous month is not accepted. ## Details

<a id="REQ-025"></a>
### REQ-025 — Web-based and mobile-responsive

**Criteria:** Delivered as a web application; every screen is usable on mobile devices through a responsive layout. Supported browsers, versions and device classes are not stated (open question).

<a id="REQ-026"></a>
### REQ-026 — Secure login and logout for all roles

**Criteria:** No function or data is reachable without authentication, for any role (Employee, Project Manager, Line Manager, Admin/HR); every user can log out, which ends the session. Authentication mode and session lifetime are not stated (open question).

<a id="REQ-027"></a>
### REQ-027 — Role-based access rights

**Criteria:** Each function and each record is available only to the roles the permission matrix allows; a user with a country-, city- or office-scoped role sees only data within that scope.

<a id="REQ-028"></a>
### REQ-028 — Scale to 33,000 users

**Criteria:** Up to 33,000 registered users across all countries and offices. The peak number of concurrent users and the response-time target under that load are not stated (open question).

<a id="REQ-029"></a>
### REQ-029 — Handle concurrent submissions without delay

**Criteria:** Concurrent submissions are processed without noticeable delay. No measurable target (response time, percentile, concurrency level) is stated (open question).

<a id="REQ-030"></a>
### REQ-030 — Reliable under heavy usage

**Criteria:** Reliable operation under heavy usage, up to 33,000 users. No availability or recovery target is stated (open question).

<a id="REQ-031"></a>
### REQ-031 — Multi-language localisation

**Criteria:** User interface and notifications can be presented in more than one language when required. The languages required are not stated (open question).

<a id="REQ-032"></a>
### REQ-032 — Use card scanner data as provided

**Criteria:** The system reads check-in/check-out times from the card scanner system and contains no scanner device or scanner data-processing logic.
